dispositions.statement: Published as printed; the heuristic ignores leverage, fees and rate timing. F27 compares income_yield_pct, the filer's printed ratio of net investment income to average net assets over the period (12.69 % annualised for the nine months to 2024-09-30; 12.30 % for the year 2024), with the weighted coupon of the published rows at the period END (10.54, 9.99). The coupon fell through 2024 (11.32, 11.23, 11.11, 10.54, 9.99 at the five quarter-ends from 2023-12-31); averaged over each period it is 11.05 and 10.84, and the ratio exceeds it by 1.64 and 1.46, inside the 2.0 band and in line with the 1.27 to 1.44 of the flat-rate quarters 2023-09-30 to 2024-03-31. Leverage less expenses alone does not explain the level (1.52 x 10.54 - 5.18 = 10.79; 1.47 x 9.99 - 5.15 = 9.54); the steady 1.3 to 1.7 points are fee, OID and leverage effects not decomposed here. Every funded loan publishes its printed rate; no value is wrong.
